{"title":"Sleep","description":"Vendor-neutral sleep — stages, efficiency, latency, HRV (Wearables data model)","defaults":{"dataSources":{"ds.search":{"options":{"queryParameters":{"latest":"$global_time.latest$","earliest":"$global_time.earliest$"}}}},"visualizations":{"global":{"showProgressBar":true}}},"inputs":{"input_global_trp":{"type":"input.timerange","options":{"token":"global_time","defaultValue":"-7d@d,now"},"title":"Time Range"},"input_person":{"type":"input.dropdown","title":"Person (temp)","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_person_list"},"options":{"token":"person","selectFirstSearchResult":true},"encoding":{"value":"primary.person_id","label":"primary.person_name"}}},"dataSources":{"ds_sleep_contributors":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` tag=wearable_sleep sleep_score=* person_id="$person$"
| where isnotnull(sleep_contrib_deep_sleep)
| dedup day
| sort -_time
| head 1
| eval "Deep Sleep"=round(sleep_contrib_deep_sleep,0), "Efficiency"=round(sleep_contrib_efficiency,0), "Latency"=round(sleep_contrib_latency,0), "REM Sleep"=round(sleep_contrib_rem_sleep,0), "Restfulness"=round(sleep_contrib_restfulness,0), "Timing"=round(sleep_contrib_timing,0), "Total Sleep"=round(sleep_contrib_total_sleep,0)
| table "Deep Sleep","Efficiency","Latency","REM Sleep","Restfulness","Timing","Total Sleep"
| transpose
| rename column as contributor, "row 1" as score
| sort -score","queryParameters":{"earliest":"-2d","latest":"now"}},"name":"Sleep score contributors"},"ds_score_trend":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` tag=wearable_sleep sleep_score=* person_id="$person$"
| dedup day
| eval Score=sleep_score
| timechart span=1d@d avg(Score) as Score","queryParameters":{"earliest":"$global_time.earliest$","latest":"$global_time.latest$"}},"name":"Sleep score trend"},"ds_sleep_score":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` tag=wearable_sleep sleep_score=* person_id="$person$"

| head 1

| table score, scolor","queryParameters":{"earliest":"-2d","latest":"now"}},"name":"Sleep score — latest (gauge)"},"ds_sleep_detail":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` tag=wearable_sleep sleep_type="long_sleep" person_id="$person$"

| eval tib=coalesce(time_in_bed_min, total_sleep_min+awake_min), sleep_hours=round(total_sleep_min/60,1), latency_min=latency_min, bed_hours=round(tib/60,1), avg_hr=round(avg_hr,1), avg_hrv=round(hrv_avg,0), low_hr=round(lowest_hr,0), efficiency=coalesce(efficiency_pct, round(100*total_sleep_min/tib,1)), ecolor=case(efficiency<75,"#E8503A",efficiency<85,"#F4A422",true(),"#4CAF50")
| table sleep_hours, bed_hours, efficiency, latency_min, avg_hr, avg_hrv, low_hr, ecolor","queryParameters":{"earliest":"-2d","latest":"now"}},"name":"Sleep detail — latest (tiles)"},"ds_duration_detail":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` tag=wearable_sleep sleep_type="long_sleep" person_id="$person$"
| dedup day sortby -total_sleep_min

| head 1

| eval Deep=deep_h." hr (".deep_pct."%)", REM=rem_h." hr (".rem_pct."%)", Light=light_h." hr (".light_pct."%)", Awake=awake_h." hr (".awake_pct."%)", "SpO2 Avg"=tostring(round(spo2_avg,1))."%"

| where isnotnull(sleep_phase_5_min)

| sort -_time
| head 1
| rex field=bedtime_start "T(?P<bed_h>\d{2}):(?P<bed_m>\d{2})"
| eval bed_h=tonumber(bed_h), bed_m=tonumber(bed_m), bed_total_mins=(bed_h*60)+bed_m
| rex field=sleep_phase_5_min max_match=0 "(?P<phases>.)"
| mvexpand phases
| streamstats count as idx
| eval offset_min=(idx-1)*5, total_mins=bed_total_mins+offset_min, h=floor(total_mins/60) % 24, m=total_mins % 60, hh=if(h<10,"0".tostring(h),tostring(h)), mm=if(m<10,"0".tostring(m),tostring(m)), time_label=hh.":".mm, sbt=strptime(bedtime_start,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), date_label=strftime(sbt+(offset_min*60),"%a %b %d"), stage=case(phases="1","Deep",phases="2","Light",phases="3","REM",phases="4","Awake",true(),"Unknown")
| where stage!="Unknown"

| sort is_self person_name

- **Sleep Score / Efficiency / Latency** — overall quality, % of time in bed asleep, and minutes to fall asleep.
- **Sleep stages** — Awake / REM / Light / Deep; the hypnogram shows the order, tiles show time + % in each.
- **Contributors** — the sub-scores Oura blends into your Sleep Score.
- These panels show your **most recent night** — the latest night in the selected time range.
